FC_ALTA.EXPR: CASE WHEN FC_ALTA IS NOT NULL THEN date_format(FC_ALTA,'yyyy-MM-dd') ELSE FC_ALTA END
CASE WHEN FC_ALTA IS NULL THEN 'Valido' WHEN CAST(FC_ALTA AS DATE)<=CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Valido' ELSE 'No valido, fecha FC_ALTA futura' END
CASE WHEN FC_ALTA IS NULL THEN 'Valido' WHEN FC_BAJA IS NULL THEN 'Valido' WHEN CAST(FC_ALTA AS DATE) <= CAST(FC_BAJA AS DATE) THEN 'Valido' ELSE 'No valido, fecha alta mayor que fecha baja' END

CASE WHEN CAST(FC_PRIMER_APUNTE AS DATE) <= CAST(FC_ULTIMO_APUNTE AS DATE) THEN 'Valido' ELSE 'No valido, FC_PRIMER_APUNTE mayor que FC_ULTIMO_APUNTE' END

DS_DIRECCION.EXPR: CASE WHEN DS_DIRECCION RLIKE  '[a-zA-Z0-9_]+([.][a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*@[a-zA-Z0-9_]+([.][a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*[.][a-zA-Z]{2,5}' THEN 'Valido' ELSE 'No valido, formato incorrecto' END

NM_KM.EXPR: CASE WHEN NM_KM IS NULL THEN 'Valido' WHEN NM_KM >= 0 THEN 'Valido' ELSE 'No Valido, valor de NM_KM no permitido' END
CASE WHEN NM_KM IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT_NUMBER( NM_KM, 2) ELSE NULL END

DS_NUMERO.EXPR: CASE WHEN DS_NUMERO IS NULL THEN 'Valido' WHEN DS_NUMERO REGEXP '^([a-zA-Z0-9 ,]*)?$' THEN 'Valido' ELSE 'No Valido, el Campo DS_NUMERO no solo contiene caracteres alfabeticos, numericos o espacios' END
CASE WHEN DS_NUMERO IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM DS_NUMERO), ' ', '') ELSE 'NC' END

DS_PUERTA.EXPR: CASE WHEN DS_PUERTA IS NULL THEN 'Valido' WHEN DS_PUERTA REGEXP '^([a-zA-Z0-9 ,]*)?$' THEN 'Valido' ELSE 'No Valido, el Campo DS_PUERTA no solo contiene caracteres alfabeticos, numericos o espacios' END
CASE WHEN DS_PUERTA IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(TRIM(REPLACE(DS_PUERTA, ' ', ''))) ELSE 'NC' END

DS_BLOQUE.EXPR: CASE WHEN DS_BLOQUE IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(TRIM(REPLACE(DS_BLOQUE , ' ', ''))) ELSE 'NC' END

DS_ESCALERA.EXPR: CASE WHEN DS_ESCALERA IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(TRIM(REPLACE(DS_ESCALERA, ' ', ''))) ELSE 'NC' END
